## Problem and scope

What user or system failure does this change address? What is intentionally out of scope?

## Evidence

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] New behavior has a synthetic positive case and bad/negative-control case where applicable
- [ ] No real child, family, teacher, production, or credential data is included
- [ ] Failure modes and rollback are documented

Paste the relevant deterministic gate summary and any blinded human-review reference. Do not paste sensitive transcripts.

## AI behavior and safety

- [ ] Does not provide answers, calculation results, or complete worked steps
- [ ] Prompt/OCR input remains untrusted data
- [ ] Model-judge scores do not override deterministic hard failures
- [ ] RTC is not enabled without fresh live evidence and human review

## Provenance and operations

- [ ] New dependencies/assets include source and license/provenance information
- [ ] No new secret, production permission, automatic deployment, or data collection path
- [ ] Documentation and release checklist updated
